description: Generic Cube wide-periodic network profile ({P} = AM/MD/PM/NT). Field derivations EMPIRICALLY LOCKED against a published narrow export (Gold-Resolver, 100% x 3 periods x 49k links). Agency-specific bindings beyond these generic Cube conventions live privately.

capacity_period_{P}.consumer: static VDF only (BPR, conical, and every non-QVDF form)
capacity_period_{P}.note: CR-0019: the static VDF computes x = source_volume_{P} / capacity_period_{P} directly. lanes, period duration and PLF play no part.

source_period_factor_{P}.note: Adapter input for building capacity_period_{P}. NEVER a kernel input. Must come from a declared period definition or a measured constant - never from a per-link inversion of source_volume, which is circular against the comparison target.

source_plf_{P}.meaning: phi / H - the retired kernel PLF
source_plf_{P}.note: Retained so legacy networks remain traceable. Not read at run time.

kd_{P}.meaning: k_d = D / (V/H), demand peaking of the congested episode
kd_{P}.note: NOT 1/PLF. That identity is WITHDRAWN (CR-0019). k_d comes from demand reconstruction on observed speed/flow; deriving it from a period factor makes the QVDF calibration circular.

kmu_{P}.meaning: k_mu = mu / C_hourly, measured queue-discharge retention
kmu_{P}.note: Supply-side. No counterpart in the legacy schema.

tap_volume_{P}.note: written back by export; never an input

tap_vc_{P}.note: written back by export; never an input

tap_speed_{P}.note: written back by export; never an input

tap_time_{P}.note: written back by export; never an input

resolver.note_limit9: limit-9 rows with lanes>0 are KEPT (restriction expressed via allowed_use, not row presence) - empirically locked

vdf_staging.status: DEVIATION-BY-CORRECTION: published narrow files carry hand-set alpha/beta + flat plf=1.0 matching no public table; authoritative-table confirmation pending from the model owner

capacity_semantics.rule: three capacities, three names, disjoint consumers
capacity_semantics.capacity_period_{P}: the static VDF, and nothing else
capacity_semantics.forbidden: scaling capacity_hourly_* by a period factor in place - it would make one field mean two things depending on consumer

G_period_basis.on_fail: STOP. The capacity is on the wrong basis and no downstream assignment number is interpretable.
G_period_basis.field_result: 31416 links, max rel err 0.00026, p95 0.00005, 100% within 0.5% - PASS

G_no_runtime_plf.expr: perturbing source_plf_{P} must not change any tap_* output when capacity_period_{P} is present
G_no_runtime_plf.note: Asserted in the kernel selftest ('PLF is inert', 'lanes are inert', 'period hours are inert') and re-checked in the field by staging a deliberately wrong vdf_plf.
